# Example CID files

SCL models from the server examples of [libiec61850](https://github.com/mz-automation/libiec61850) (`examples/server_example_*`, revision `6e265c54af66ea686453b6d31c4dcce1cf7ad2bd`), used as parser test input by `scl/dispatch_test.go` and the sclparse tests. They are licensed by their authors under GPL-3.0-only and are test data only: no part of the go-iec61850 library or its tools.
